[Story]
Mr. Liu, the father, smokes for many years. His son, Xiao Liu, participates in the health education activities at school and hopes to persuade his father to quit smoking.

[Question]
How does Xiao Liu persuade his father?

[Candidate Answers]
A. He expresses his care and love for his father, saying he is afraid of losing him.
B. He suggests his father to have a health check-up to understand his own health condition.
C. He expresses his wish for his father to live a long life and accompany the family.
D. He calculates and shows how much money smoking can cost in a year, which can be used for more meaningful things.
